Title: Generally Available: Azure Red Hat OpenShift in Indonesia Central

Body.Content:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift (ARO) is now generally available in the Indonesia Central Azure region, expanding regional availability for customers running mission‑critical OpenShift workloads on Azure. This release enables organizations in Indonesia and the broader Southeast Asia region to deploy fully managed Red Hat OpenShift clusters with integrated Azure security, networking, and operations. 

With GA availability in Indonesia Central, customers can modernize applications, run regulated and latency‑sensitive workloads closer to end users, and meet local data residency requirements. ARO provides a consistent OpenShift experience across on‑premises and cloud environments while offloading day‑2 operations such as upgrades, patching, and cluster management to Microsoft and Red Hat. 

This regional expansion helps customers accelerate application modernization and hybrid cloud strategies on Azure using a jointly operated, enterprise‑grade OpenShift service.
